using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Args
{
    public class CommandLineArgs
    {
        public string Target { get; }
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Options { get; }

        public CommandLineArgs(string target, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> options)
        {
            Target = target;
            Options = options;
        }

        public static CommandLineArgs FromArgs(string[] args)
        {
            if (args == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(args));
            }

            var target = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : null;
            var options = args.Skip(1)
                .Select(arg => arg.Split('='))
                .ToDictionary(
                    parts => parts[0],
                    parts => parts.Length > 1 ? parts[1] : null
                );

            return new CommandLineArgs(target, options);
        }
    }
}
